description: This file defines a class 'QuestionGeneratorNodes' that encapsulates multiple nodes for a workflow related to medical exam question generation, validation, and context retrieval. It interacts with external AI services, vector stores, image processing, and storage systems to generate and validate exam questions in a structured pipeline.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: A class implementing multiple nodes for a question generation workflow, including context retrieval, question creation, validation, and citation addition, specifically tailored for medical exam questions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the QuestionGeneratorNodes with AI client, embedding manager, image processor, vector store, and storage, and sets up caches.

methods.name: _get_cached_questions
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a chapter with caching to reduce disk I/O.

methods.name: _calculate_question_similarity
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: _extract_medical_terms
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: _is_question_unique
methods.description: Checks if a question is unique based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: _extract_covered_topics
methods.description: Extracts main topics from recent questions to avoid repetition.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores
methods.description: Tracks quality scores for source chunks based on question confidence.

methods.name: retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context chunks from vector store with smart selection based on existing questions and difficulty.

methods.name: generate_question
methods.description: Generates a new exam question using GPT, incorporating context and images, and checks for uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_accuracy
methods.description: Validates the generated question for medical accuracy and quality.

methods.name: add_citations
methods.description: Finalizes the question by adding source metadata, confidence scores, and updating quality metrics.
